en:
There's one thing I can do.
I'll support you with my magic.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Himiko for a while?

Hmph, leave it to me.
Nothing's impossible with my magic!

But there's a limit to even my magical powers...
Make sure you understand that.
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
